hotels.title: North Carolina: Sophisticated Downtown Asheville City Break Overlooking Blue Ridge Ranges
hotels.description: Cradled by the spellbindingly blue Appalachians and positioned in the heart of North Carolina’s most breathtaking creative city, Kimpton Hotel Arras, an IHG Hotel offers guests a unique chance to experience Asheville’s signature hospitality. Spend your days exploring the \"Paris of the South\" - hike the Blue Ridges or sip your way across countless microbreweries - and return to laidback Mediterranean-inspired plates at Bargelo and masterfully prepared artisanal cocktails at District 42.
